title: Austin Sets City Goals, Discusses Land & Water
summary:
*   City leaders held a special meeting to outline new strategic priorities and long-term goals for Austin.
*   Officials met in private to discuss significant city business, including potential land acquisitions, ongoing legal cases, and key staff appointments.
*   David Price was appointed to the crucial Water & Wastewater Commission, which oversees the city's essential water services.
